title: checkUnitContracts
responsibility: Compares stored contracts with indexed source and state inventories, reporting located heuristic gaps and per-entity totals without rewriting contracts.

inputs.name: checkUnitContracts.id
inputs.description: An optional stored unit id passed to guidanceUnit when a single unit is selected. Exactly one of id and options.all must be truthy, or the selection check throws.

inputs.name: checkUnitContracts.options
inputs.description: The guidance options passed to guidanceContext, with all selecting every active stored unit when no id is supplied. This workflow reads all directly and forwards the remaining options to the context builder.

inputs.name: renderContractCheck.report
inputs.description: A completed check report containing entity ids, findings, per-entity counts, and totals. The renderer consumes these fields directly and does not rerun the checks.

outputs.name: checkUnitContracts
outputs.description: A promise resolving to selected entity ids, located findings, per-entity counts, and overall totals. all considers active stored units, while an id selects one unit; findings remain heuristic.

outputs.name: renderContractCheck
outputs.description: A newline-joined string with one count line per entity, one line per finding with its entity, kind, detail, and location, and a final total line. The final line labels the result as heuristic rather than a completeness proof.
examples:
workflow.development-tooling-check-unit-contracts: 0 findings
0 findings across 1 entities. Heuristic review; not a completeness proof.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The selection check invokes fail('Select one unit identity or --all.') when Boolean(id) and Boolean(options.all) are equal. This occurs before guidance context is loaded.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Errors from context loading, unit resolution, state/test collection, contract derivation, or uid finding propagate because the workflow does not catch them. The originating failure is passed through by this workflow.
